_doc: Curated public-domain Unsplash URLs per (archetype × slot). The fetch-theme-images.mjs script reads this when UNSPLASH_ACCESS_KEY is not set. Each URL must be VERIFIED — don't add fabricated photo IDs. Seeded from existing Unsplash references already in use in app/themes/. To expand: visit unsplash.com, find a real image, copy its photo URL, paste it under the right (archetype, slot). For full automation, set UNSPLASH_ACCESS_KEY in .env and the script switches to live API mode.
_attributionPolicy: Unsplash photos are free for commercial and non-commercial use. Attribution is appreciated, not required (per Unsplash License). Where the photographer name is known we include it for the dashboard's image-credit panel.
